title: Landet: an efficient physics-informed deep learning approach for automatic detection of anatomical landmarks and measurement of spinopelvic alignment
summary: LanDet uses a physics-informed deep model to measure five spinopelvic parameters from radiographs; the abstract reports evaluation against held-out manual labels and surgeon annotations. The result is limited to the reported samples, datasets, and assays; broader transfer and downstream utility were not established.
organization: Department of Systems Design Engineering, University of Waterloo, Waterloo, Canada
